title: Turn off the terminal cursor blink that costs idle CPU
notes: Measured: focused terminal, nothing happening: renderer 3.7-5% CPU, ~70 style recalcs/s, +1% main, +1% GPU; 0.1% with xterm's animation off. Where: cursorBlink: true at src/renderer/app/page.ts:318; xterm DOM renderer blinks via CSS keyframes on background-color. Fix (small): cursorBlink off, or a setting defaulting off. Rerun: measure.mjs keys (last step). From profiling card dca04e6f, docs/performance/history.md 2026-11-02.
